description: Queue video library entries for upload to a YouTube channel. A timer (every 5 min) uploads them one after another without further calls, with subtitles and poster as thumbnail, and stores the YouTube link on the entry. When YouTube's daily quota is used up, the queue pauses until the quota resets (midnight Pacific time) and continues by itself. Privacy is private or unlisted; public needs update_youtube_video and a human approval. Entries that already have a YouTube link or are already queued are skipped. Order = order of items.

channel_id.description: YouTube channel id (UC…) from list_youtube_channels; optional when only one channel is connected

language.description: omit: every language the entry has

library_slug.description: Slug of the video library entry

privacy.description: default private. Public only via update_youtube_video with human approval.

name: queue_youtube_uploads
